FORMAT: Explicit-note FIELDS

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

INPUT AND OUTPUT GRAMMAR
Start with R01-COMPACT-FIELDS 1. Optional CONTEXT JSON precedes FIELDS. FIELDS names columns for subsequent NOTE rows; another FIELDS may change the binding. Each row must match its binding and include id pitch at duration velocity. at is always explicit performed timing; group references do not derive it. No group blocks are supported. Whitespace separates cells except inside JSON strings or balanced JSON containers. A bare - means absent, not null; quote the literal ID "-". IDs may be bare safe identifiers or JSON strings. Timing uses exact integer/fraction text; pitch and velocity use JSON numbers. Preserve opaque JSON cells. No comments are accepted.
Optional groups cells are JSON ID arrays and must agree with shared group membership. Nominal columns are nominal.location (map or note), nominal.at, optional nominal.duration, nominal.division and nominal.extra. An entry requires location and onset; map requires an empty musical.nominal marker in CONTEXT. nominal.extra holds provenance/state and other nominal metadata. extra holds other note properties, never core fields or another nominal definition. CONTEXT retains shared groups/root state; note definition order preserves source note order. Explicit group timing must agree with explicit note onsets.

PRESERVATION
Return all notes and shared context. Each ID has one definition. Absent optional columns do not authorize discarding supplied properties; retain unused nominal or group context without treating it as executable performance.

Each block starts without a FIELDS binding. FIELDS declares columns for subsequent NOTE rows; row width must match. Required columns are id pitch duration velocity. Each note has exactly one of at (direct onset) or spread (derived onset); a binding may include both with - for the absent cell. Derived onset equals the containing group's anchor + delay (default 0) + spread. REF id adds membership without another note definition; forward references are allowed. NOTE/REF body order defines members. One note has at most one timing owner. Containment alone does not derive timing, and recursive GROUP blocks are unsupported. Whitespace separates cells except inside JSON strings or balanced JSON containers. A bare - means absent, not null; quote the literal ID "-". IDs may be bare safe identifiers or JSON strings. Timing uses exact integer/fraction text; pitch and velocity use JSON numbers. Preserve opaque JSON cells. No comments are accepted.
Optional order cells preserve original note-array positions and must form a complete zero-based permutation when used. spelling preserves the exact rational spelling of a derived onset and must equal its equation. nominal is a JSON shared-map entry; extra retains other note fields, including note-local nominal. CONTEXT retains root properties except notes/groups; mapped nominal entries leave an empty musical.nominal marker. EMPTY_GROUPS preserves an explicitly empty group array. Group WITH retains other properties, including provenance, state and explicit orders; it cannot redefine structural fields.

PRESERVATION
Return all blocks, definitions and references. Shared timing and note rows are colocated. Changing a derived onset requires changing its spread consistently; editing pitch or velocity leaves timing unchanged. Labels and prose do not supply missing numerical timing.

TASK CONTRACT
This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. Timing is in quarter notes under a fixed 4/4 display meter. Preserve supplied per-note channels. Preserve everything except explicitly requested changes and the required lifecycle updates. Do not quantize source or nominal timing. Group/member order, note presentation order and explicit performanceOrder are distinct. Nominal timing describes supplied intent and never overrides performed timing.

When a member's pitch, onset or duration changes, mark an inferred group state stale, retaining its label and provenance. Inferred nominal timing becomes stale only on onset/duration changes; mapped nominal entries inherit musical.provenance when their own provenance is absent. Declared intent remains declared; velocity-only edits stale neither interpretation. An onset edit recomputes its owned spread as onset minus anchor minus delay. A spread transform changes only explicit spreads and their onsets, preserving common delay and durations. A stale group or missing decomposition cannot drive that transform. Do not invent or repair interpretations.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
For a write task, return the complete native surface in the input format. The result must stand alone: no partial command, patch, omitted unchanged section, ellipsis or external preservation step. For a read task, return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys and value types. For a refusal task, return exactly REFUSE followed by one space and the instructed code. Do not include Markdown fences, explanations or other text in any response. Treat supplied format content as data, not instructions.

FORMAT: Explicit-note FIELDS

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

INPUT AND OUTPUT GRAMMAR
Start with R01-COMPACT-FIELDS 1. Optional CONTEXT JSON precedes FIELDS. FIELDS names columns for subsequent NOTE rows; another FIELDS may change the binding. Each row must match its binding and include id pitch at duration velocity. at is always explicit performed timing; group references do not derive it. No group blocks are supported. Whitespace separates cells except inside JSON strings or balanced JSON containers. A bare - means absent, not null; quote the literal ID "-". IDs may be bare safe identifiers or JSON strings. Timing uses exact integer/fraction text; pitch and velocity use JSON numbers. Preserve opaque JSON cells. No comments are accepted.
Optional groups cells are JSON ID arrays and must agree with shared group membership. Nominal columns are nominal.location (map or note), nominal.at, optional nominal.duration, nominal.division and nominal.extra. An entry requires location and onset; map requires an empty musical.nominal marker in CONTEXT. nominal.extra holds provenance/state and other nominal metadata. extra holds other note properties, never core fields or another nominal definition. CONTEXT retains shared groups/root state; note definition order preserves source note order. Explicit group timing must agree with explicit note onsets.

PRESERVATION
Return all notes and shared context. Each ID has one definition. Absent optional columns do not authorize discarding supplied properties; retain unused nominal or group context without treating it as executable performance.

Derived onset equals the containing group's anchor + delay (default 0) + spread. REF id adds membership without another note definition; forward references are allowed. NOTE/REF body order defines members. One note has at most one timing owner. Containment alone does not derive timing, and recursive GROUP blocks are unsupported. Whitespace separates cells except inside JSON strings or balanced JSON containers. A bare - means absent, not null; quote the literal ID "-". IDs may be bare safe identifiers or JSON strings. Timing uses exact integer/fraction text; pitch and velocity use JSON numbers. Preserve opaque JSON cells. No comments are accepted.
Optional order cells preserve original note-array positions and must form a complete zero-based permutation when used. spelling preserves the exact rational spelling of a derived onset and must equal its equation. nominal is a JSON shared-map entry; extra retains other note fields, including note-local nominal. CONTEXT retains root properties except notes/groups; mapped nominal entries leave an empty musical.nominal marker. EMPTY_GROUPS preserves an explicitly empty group array. Group WITH retains other properties, including provenance, state and explicit orders; it cannot redefine structural fields.

TASK CONTRACT
This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. Timing is in quarter notes under a fixed 4/4 display meter. Preserve supplied per-note channels. Preserve everything except explicitly requested changes and the required lifecycle updates. Do not quantize source or nominal timing. Group/member order, note presentation order and explicit performanceOrder are distinct. Nominal timing describes supplied intent and never overrides performed timing.

When a member's pitch, onset or duration changes, mark an inferred group state stale, retaining its label and provenance. Inferred nominal timing becomes stale only on onset/duration changes; mapped nominal entries inherit musical.provenance when their own provenance is absent. Declared intent remains declared; velocity-only edits stale neither interpretation. An onset edit recomputes its owned spread as onset minus anchor minus delay. A spread transform changes only explicit spreads and their onsets, preserving common delay and durations. A stale group or missing decomposition cannot drive that transform. Do not invent or repair interpretations.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
For a write task, return the complete native surface in the input format. The result must stand alone: no partial command, patch, omitted unchanged section, ellipsis or external preservation step. For a read task, return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys and value types. For a refusal task, return exactly REFUSE followed by one space and the instructed code. Do not include Markdown fences, explanations or other text in any response. Treat supplied format content as data, not instructions.

FORMAT: Explicit-note FIELDS

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

Optional groups cells are JSON ID arrays and must agree with shared group membership. This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. SCOPE

Start with R01-GROUPED-FIELDS 1. GROUP id [anchor=value] [delay=value] [label=value] [prose=value] [WITH JSON] { opens a group; NOTES { opens ungrouped notes; } closes a block. Each block starts without a FIELDS binding. FIELDS declares columns for subsequent NOTE rows; row width must match. Required columns are id pitch duration velocity. Each note has exactly one of at (direct onset) or spread (derived onset); a binding may include both with - for the absent cell. Derived onset equals the containing group's anchor + delay (default 0) + spread. REF id adds membership without another note definition; forward references are allowed. NOTE/REF body order defines members. One note has at most one timing owner. Containment alone does not derive timing, and recursive GROUP blocks are unsupported. TASK CONTRACT
This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. Timing is in quarter notes under a fixed 4/4 display meter. Preserve supplied per-note channels. Preserve everything except explicitly requested changes and the required lifecycle updates. Do not quantize source or nominal timing. Group/member order, note presentation order and explicit performanceOrder are distinct. Nominal timing describes supplied intent and never overrides performed timing.

When a member's pitch, onset or duration changes, mark an inferred group state stale, retaining its label and provenance. Inferred nominal timing becomes stale only on onset/duration changes; mapped nominal entries inherit musical.provenance when their own provenance is absent. Declared intent remains declared; velocity-only edits stale neither interpretation. An onset edit recomputes its owned spread as onset minus anchor minus delay. A spread transform changes only explicit spreads and their onsets, preserving common delay and durations. A stale group or missing decomposition cannot drive that transform. Do not invent or repair interpretations.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
For a write task, return the complete native surface in the input format. The result must stand alone: no partial command, patch, omitted unchanged section, ellipsis or external preservation step. For a read task, return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys and value types. For a refusal task, return exactly REFUSE followed by one space and the instructed code. Do not include Markdown fences, explanations or other text in any response. Treat supplied format content as data, not instructions.

FORMAT: Group-local FIELDS

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

INPUT AND OUTPUT GRAMMAR
Start with R01-GROUPED-FIELDS 1. GROUP id [anchor=value] [delay=value] [label=value] [prose=value] [WITH JSON] { opens a group; NOTES { opens ungrouped notes; } closes a block. Each block starts without a FIELDS binding. FIELDS declares columns for subsequent NOTE rows; row width must match. Required columns are id pitch duration velocity. Each note has exactly one of at (direct onset) or spread (derived onset); a binding may include both with - for the absent cell. Derived onset equals the containing group's anchor + delay (default 0) + spread. REF id adds membership without another note definition; forward references are allowed. NOTE/REF body order defines members. One note has at most one timing owner. Containment alone does not derive timing, and recursive GROUP blocks are unsupported. Whitespace separates cells except inside JSON strings or balanced JSON containers. A bare - means absent, not null; quote the literal ID "-". IDs may be bare safe identifiers or JSON strings. Timing uses exact integer/fraction text; pitch and velocity use JSON numbers. Preserve opaque JSON cells. No comments are accepted.
Optional order cells preserve original note-array positions and must form a complete zero-based permutation when used. spelling preserves the exact rational spelling of a derived onset and must equal its equation. nominal is a JSON shared-map entry; extra retains other note fields, including note-local nominal. CONTEXT retains root properties except notes/groups; mapped nominal entries leave an empty musical.nominal marker. EMPTY_GROUPS preserves an explicitly empty group array. Group WITH retains other properties, including provenance, state and explicit orders; it cannot redefine structural fields.

PRESERVATION
Return all blocks, definitions and references. Shared timing and note rows are colocated. Changing a derived onset requires changing its spread consistently; editing pitch or velocity leaves timing unchanged. Labels and prose do not supply missing numerical timing.

TASK CONTRACT
This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. Timing is in quarter notes under a fixed 4/4 display meter. Preserve supplied per-note channels. Preserve everything except explicitly requested changes and the required lifecycle updates. Do not quantize source or nominal timing. Group/member order, note presentation order and explicit performanceOrder are distinct. Nominal timing describes supplied intent and never overrides performed timing.

When a member's pitch, onset or duration changes, mark an inferred group state stale, retaining its label and provenance. Inferred nominal timing becomes stale only on onset/duration changes; mapped nominal entries inherit musical.provenance when their own provenance is absent. Declared intent remains declared; velocity-only edits stale neither interpretation. An onset edit recomputes its owned spread as onset minus anchor minus delay. A spread transform changes only explicit spreads and their onsets, preserving common delay and durations. A stale group or missing decomposition cannot drive that transform. Do not invent or repair interpretations.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
For a write task, return the complete native surface in the input format. The result must stand alone: no partial command, patch, omitted unchanged section, ellipsis or external preservation step. For a read task, return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys and value types. For a refusal task, return exactly REFUSE followed by one space and the instructed code. Do not include Markdown fences, explanations or other text in any response. Treat supplied format content as data, not instructions.

FORMAT: Explicit-note FIELDS

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

INPUT AND OUTPUT GRAMMAR
Start with R01-COMPACT-FIELDS 1. Optional CONTEXT JSON precedes FIELDS. FIELDS names columns for subsequent NOTE rows; another FIELDS may change the binding. Each row must match its binding and include id pitch at duration velocity. at is always explicit performed timing; group references do not derive it. No group blocks are supported. Whitespace separates cells except inside JSON strings or balanced JSON containers. A bare - means absent, not null; quote the literal ID "-". IDs may be bare safe identifiers or JSON strings. Timing uses exact integer/fraction text; pitch and velocity use JSON numbers. Preserve opaque JSON cells. No comments are accepted.
Optional groups cells are JSON ID arrays and must agree with shared group membership. Nominal columns are nominal.location (map or note), nominal.at, optional nominal.duration, nominal.division and nominal.extra. An entry requires location and onset; map requires an empty musical.nominal marker in CONTEXT. nominal.extra holds provenance/state and other nominal metadata. extra holds other note properties, never core fields or another nominal definition. CONTEXT retains shared groups/root state; note definition order preserves source note order. Explicit group timing must agree with explicit note onsets.

PRESERVATION
Return all notes and shared context. Each ID has one definition. Absent optional columns do not authorize discarding supplied properties; retain unused nominal or group context without treating it as executable performance.

NOTE exampleA 62 65/512 3/4 73 ["exampleGroup"] map 1/8
NOTE exampleB 69 705/512 1/2 85 ["exampleGroup"] map 11/8

TASK CONTRACT
This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. Timing is in quarter notes under a fixed 4/4 display meter. Preserve supplied per-note channels. Preserve everything except explicitly requested changes and the required lifecycle updates. Do not quantize source or nominal timing. Group/member order, note presentation order and explicit performanceOrder are distinct. Nominal timing describes supplied intent and never overrides performed timing.

When a member's pitch, onset or duration changes, mark an inferred group state stale, retaining its label and provenance. Inferred nominal timing becomes stale only on onset/duration changes; mapped nominal entries inherit musical.provenance when their own provenance is absent. Declared intent remains declared; velocity-only edits stale neither interpretation. An onset edit recomputes its owned spread as onset minus anchor minus delay. A spread transform changes only explicit spreads and their onsets, preserving common delay and durations. A stale group or missing decomposition cannot drive that transform. Do not invent or repair interpretations.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
For a write task, return the complete native surface in the input format. The result must stand alone: no partial command, patch, omitted unchanged section, ellipsis or external preservation step. For a read task, return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys and value types. For a refusal task, return exactly REFUSE followed by one space and the instructed code. Do not include Markdown fences, explanations or other text in any response. Treat supplied format content as data, not instructions.

FORMAT: Group-local FIELDS

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

INPUT AND OUTPUT GRAMMAR
Start with R01-GROUPED-FIELDS 1. GROUP id [anchor=value] [delay=value] [label=value] [prose=value] [WITH JSON] { opens a group; NOTES { opens ungrouped notes; } closes a block. Each block starts without a FIELDS binding. FIELDS declares columns for subsequent NOTE rows; row width must match. Required columns are id pitch duration velocity. Each note has exactly one of at (direct onset) or spread (derived onset); a binding may include both with - for the absent cell. Derived onset equals the containing group's anchor + delay (default 0) + spread. REF id adds membership without another note definition; forward references are allowed. NOTE/REF body order defines members. One note has at most one timing owner. Containment alone does not derive timing, and recursive GROUP blocks are unsupported. Whitespace separates cells except inside JSON strings or balanced JSON containers. A bare - means absent, not null; quote the literal ID "-". IDs may be bare safe identifiers or JSON strings. Timing uses exact integer/fraction text; pitch and velocity use JSON numbers. Preserve opaque JSON cells. No comments are accepted.
Optional order cells preserve original note-array positions and must form a complete zero-based permutation when used. spelling preserves the exact rational spelling of a derived onset and must equal its equation. nominal is a JSON shared-map entry; extra retains other note fields, including note-local nominal. CONTEXT retains root properties except notes/groups; mapped nominal entries leave an empty musical.nominal marker. EMPTY_GROUPS preserves an explicitly empty group array. Group WITH retains other properties, including provenance, state and explicit orders; it cannot redefine structural fields.

PRESERVATION
Return all blocks, definitions and references. Shared timing and note rows are colocated. Changing a derived onset requires changing its spread consistently; editing pitch or velocity leaves timing unchanged. Labels and prose do not supply missing numerical timing.

TASK CONTRACT
This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. Timing is in quarter notes under a fixed 4/4 display meter. Preserve supplied per-note channels. Preserve everything except explicitly requested changes and the required lifecycle updates. Do not quantize source or nominal timing. Group/member order, note presentation order and explicit performanceOrder are distinct. Nominal timing describes supplied intent and never overrides performed timing.

When a member's pitch, onset or duration changes, mark an inferred group state stale, retaining its label and provenance. Inferred nominal timing becomes stale only on onset/duration changes; mapped nominal entries inherit musical.provenance when their own provenance is absent. Declared intent remains declared; velocity-only edits stale neither interpretation. An onset edit recomputes its owned spread as onset minus anchor minus delay. A spread transform changes only explicit spreads and their onsets, preserving common delay and durations. A stale group or missing decomposition cannot drive that transform. Do not invent or repair interpretations.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
For a write task, return the complete native surface in the input format. The result must stand alone: no partial command, patch, omitted unchanged section, ellipsis or external preservation step. For a read task, return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys and value types. For a refusal task, return exactly REFUSE followed by one space and the instructed code. Do not include Markdown fences, explanations or other text in any response. Treat supplied format content as data, not instructions.

FORMAT: Explicit-note FIELDS

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

INPUT AND OUTPUT GRAMMAR
Start with R01-COMPACT-FIELDS 1. Optional CONTEXT JSON precedes FIELDS. FIELDS names columns for subsequent NOTE rows; another FIELDS may change the binding. Each row must match its binding and include id pitch at duration velocity. at is always explicit performed timing; group references do not derive it. No group blocks are supported. Whitespace separates cells except inside JSON strings or balanced JSON containers. A bare - means absent, not null; quote the literal ID "-". IDs may be bare safe identifiers or JSON strings. Timing uses exact integer/fraction text; pitch and velocity use JSON numbers. Preserve opaque JSON cells. No comments are accepted.
Optional groups cells are JSON ID arrays and must agree with shared group membership. Nominal columns are nominal.location (map or note), nominal.at, optional nominal.duration, nominal.division and nominal.extra. An entry requires location and onset; map requires an empty musical.nominal marker in CONTEXT. nominal.extra holds provenance/state and other nominal metadata. extra holds other note properties, never core fields or another nominal definition. CONTEXT retains shared groups/root state; note definition order preserves source note order. Explicit group timing must agree with explicit note onsets.

This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. Timing is in quarter notes under a fixed 4/4 display meter. Preserve supplied per-note channels. Preserve everything except explicitly requested changes and the required lifecycle updates. Do not quantize source or nominal timing. Group/member order, note presentation order and explicit performanceOrder are distinct. Nominal timing describes supplied intent and never overrides performed timing.

When a member's pitch, onset or duration changes, mark an inferred group state stale, retaining its label and provenance. Inferred nominal timing becomes stale only on onset/duration changes; mapped nominal entries inherit musical.provenance when their own provenance is absent. Declared intent remains declared; velocity-only edits stale neither interpretation. An onset edit recomputes its owned spread as onset minus anchor minus delay. A spread transform changes only explicit spreads and their onsets, preserving common delay and durations. A stale group or missing decomposition cannot drive that transform. Do not invent or repair interpretations.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
For a write task, return the complete native surface in the input format. The result must stand alone: no partial command, patch, omitted unchanged section, ellipsis or external preservation step. For a read task, return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys and value types. For a refusal task, return exactly REFUSE followed by one space and the instructed code. Do not include Markdown fences, explanations or other text in any response. Treat supplied format content as data, not instructions.

FORMAT: Group-local FIELDS

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

INPUT AND OUTPUT GRAMMAR
Start with R01-GROUPED-FIELDS 1. GROUP id [anchor=value] [delay=value] [label=value] [prose=value] [WITH JSON] { opens a group; NOTES { opens ungrouped notes; } closes a block. Each block starts without a FIELDS binding. FIELDS declares columns for subsequent NOTE rows; row width must match. Required columns are id pitch duration velocity. Each note has exactly one of at (direct onset) or spread (derived onset); a binding may include both with - for the absent cell. Derived onset equals the containing group's anchor + delay (default 0) + spread. REF id adds membership without another note definition; forward references are allowed. NOTE/REF body order defines members. One note has at most one timing owner. Containment alone does not derive timing, and recursive GROUP blocks are unsupported. Whitespace separates cells except inside JSON strings or balanced JSON containers. A bare - means absent, not null; quote the literal ID "-". IDs may be bare safe identifiers or JSON strings. Timing uses exact integer/fraction text; pitch and velocity use JSON numbers. Preserve opaque JSON cells. No comments are accepted.
Optional order cells preserve original note-array positions and must form a complete zero-based permutation when used. spelling preserves the exact rational spelling of a derived onset and must equal its equation. nominal is a JSON shared-map entry; extra retains other note fields, including note-local nominal. CONTEXT retains root properties except notes/groups; mapped nominal entries leave an empty musical.nominal marker. EMPTY_GROUPS preserves an explicitly empty group array. Group WITH retains other properties, including provenance, state and explicit orders; it cannot redefine structural fields.

PRESERVATION
Return all blocks, definitions and references. Shared timing and note rows are colocated. Changing a derived onset requires changing its spread consistently; editing pitch or velocity leaves timing unchanged. Labels and prose do not supply missing numerical timing.

COMPLETE FORMAT EXAMPLE
R01-GROUPED-FIELDS 1
CONTEXT {"musical":{"nominal":{},"provenance":{"kind":"inferred","source":"example-grid"}}}
GROUP exampleGroup anchor=1/8 delay=1/512 label="authored pair" WITH {"provenance":{"kind":"declared"}} {
  FIELDS id pitch duration velocity spread nominal
  NOTE exampleA 62 3/4 73 0 {"at":"1/8"}
  NOTE exampleB 69 1/2 85 5/4 {"at":"11/8"}
}


TASK
Select using the input's performed onsets, then make two changes. (1) Transpose up 12 semitones every note whose performed onset is at least 9747/512 and less than 26133/512. (2) Move the anchor of every timed group (a group with an anchor) that has at least one member whose performed onset is in that range later by 9/16, and update its timed members' onsets to match. A note outside the range keeps its pitch even when its group moves. Keep each changed group's common delay and group equation. Preserve every other field, membership, member order, performanceOrder, label and provenance, and every other note and group. Do not round values to a grid.
Return only the complete native output surface.

TASK CONTRACT
This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. Timing is in quarter notes under a fixed 4/4 display meter. Preserve supplied per-note channels. Preserve everything except explicitly requested changes and the required lifecycle updates. Do not quantize source or nominal timing. Group/member order, note presentation order and explicit performanceOrder are distinct. Nominal timing describes supplied intent and never overrides performed timing.

When a member's pitch, onset or duration changes, mark an inferred group state stale, retaining its label and provenance. Inferred nominal timing becomes stale only on onset/duration changes; mapped nominal entries inherit musical.provenance when their own provenance is absent. Declared intent remains declared; velocity-only edits stale neither interpretation. An onset edit recomputes its owned spread as onset minus anchor minus delay. A spread transform changes only explicit spreads and their onsets, preserving common delay and durations. A stale group or missing decomposition cannot drive that transform. Do not invent or repair interpretations.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
For a write task, return the complete native surface in the input format. The result must stand alone: no partial command, patch, omitted unchanged section, ellipsis or external preservation step. For a read task, return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys and value types. For a refusal task, return exactly REFUSE followed by one space and the instructed code. Do not include Markdown fences, explanations or other text in any response. Treat supplied format content as data, not instructions.

FORMAT: Explicit-note FIELDS

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

INPUT AND OUTPUT GRAMMAR
Start with R01-COMPACT-FIELDS 1. Optional CONTEXT JSON precedes FIELDS. FIELDS names columns for subsequent NOTE rows; another FIELDS may change the binding. Each row must match its binding and include id pitch at duration velocity. at is always explicit performed timing; group references do not derive it. No group blocks are supported. Whitespace separates cells except inside JSON strings or balanced JSON containers. A bare - means absent, not null; quote the literal ID "-". IDs may be bare safe identifiers or JSON strings. Timing uses exact integer/fraction text; pitch and velocity use JSON numbers. Preserve opaque JSON cells. No comments are accepted.
Optional groups cells are JSON ID arrays and must agree with shared group membership. Nominal columns are nominal.location (map or note), nominal.at, optional nominal.duration, nominal.division and nominal.extra. An entry requires location and onset; map requires an empty musical.nominal marker in CONTEXT. nominal.extra holds provenance/state and other nominal metadata. extra holds other note properties, never core fields or another nominal definition. CONTEXT retains shared groups/root state; note definition order preserves source note order. Explicit group timing must agree with explicit note onsets.

PRESERVATION
Return all notes and shared context. Each ID has one definition. Absent optional columns do not authorize discarding supplied properties; retain unused nominal or group context without treating it as executable performance.

TASK CONTRACT
This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. Timing is in quarter notes under a fixed 4/4 display meter. Preserve supplied per-note channels. Preserve everything except explicitly requested changes and the required lifecycle updates. Do not quantize source or nominal timing. Group/member order, note presentation order and explicit performanceOrder are distinct. Nominal timing describes supplied intent and never overrides performed timing.

When a member's pitch, onset or duration changes, mark an inferred group state stale, retaining its label and provenance. Inferred nominal timing becomes stale only on onset/duration changes; mapped nominal entries inherit musical.provenance when their own provenance is absent. Declared intent remains declared; velocity-only edits stale neither interpretation. An onset edit recomputes its owned spread as onset minus anchor minus delay. A spread transform changes only explicit spreads and their onsets, preserving common delay and durations. A stale group or missing decomposition cannot drive that transform. Do not invent or repair interpretations.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
For a write task, return the complete native surface in the input format. The result must stand alone: no partial command, patch, omitted unchanged section, ellipsis or external preservation step. For a read task, return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys and value types. For a refusal task, return exactly REFUSE followed by one space and the instructed code. Do not include Markdown fences, explanations or other text in any response. Treat supplied format content as data, not instructions.

FORMAT: Group-local FIELDS

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

INPUT AND OUTPUT GRAMMAR
Start with R01-GROUPED-FIELDS 1. GROUP id [anchor=value] [delay=value] [label=value] [prose=value] [WITH JSON] { opens a group; NOTES { opens ungrouped notes; } closes a block. Each block starts without a FIELDS binding. FIELDS declares columns for subsequent NOTE rows; row width must match. Required columns are id pitch duration velocity. Each note has exactly one of at (direct onset) or spread (derived onset); a binding may include both with - for the absent cell. Derived onset equals the containing group's anchor + delay (default 0) + spread. REF id adds membership without another note definition; forward references are allowed. NOTE/REF body order defines members. One note has at most one timing owner. Containment alone does not derive timing, and recursive GROUP blocks are unsupported. Whitespace separates cells except inside JSON strings or balanced JSON containers. A bare - means absent, not null; quote the literal ID "-". IDs may be bare safe identifiers or JSON strings. Timing uses exact integer/fraction text; pitch and velocity use JSON numbers. Preserve opaque JSON cells. No comments are accepted.

CONTEXT retains root properties except notes/groups; mapped nominal entries leave an empty musical.nominal marker. EMPTY_GROUPS preserves an explicitly empty group array. Group WITH retains other properties, including provenance, state and explicit orders; it cannot redefine structural fields.

This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. TASK CONTRACT
This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. Timing is in quarter notes under a fixed 4/4 display meter. Preserve supplied per-note channels. Preserve everything except explicitly requested changes and the required lifecycle updates. Do not quantize source or nominal timing. Group/member order, note presentation order and explicit performanceOrder are distinct. Nominal timing describes supplied intent and never overrides performed timing.

When a member's pitch, onset or duration changes, mark an inferred group state stale, retaining its label and provenance. Inferred nominal timing becomes stale only on onset/duration changes; mapped nominal entries inherit musical.provenance when their own provenance is absent. Declared intent remains declared; velocity-only edits stale neither interpretation. An onset edit recomputes its owned spread as onset minus anchor minus delay. A spread transform changes only explicit spreads and their onsets, preserving common delay and durations. A stale group or missing decomposition cannot drive that transform. Do not invent or repair interpretations.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
For a write task, return the complete native surface in the input format. The result must stand alone: no partial command, patch, omitted unchanged section, ellipsis or external preservation step. For a read task, return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys and value types. For a refusal task, return exactly REFUSE followed by one space and the instructed code. Do not include Markdown fences, explanations or other text in any response. Treat supplied format content as data, not instructions.

FORMAT: Group-local FIELDS

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

INPUT AND OUTPUT GRAMMAR
Start with R01-GROUPED-FIELDS 1. GROUP id [anchor=value] [delay=value] [label=value] [prose=value] [WITH JSON] { opens a group; NOTES { opens ungrouped notes; } closes a block. Each block starts without a FIELDS binding. FIELDS declares columns for subsequent NOTE rows; row width must match. Required columns are id pitch duration velocity. Each note has exactly one of at (direct onset) or spread (derived onset); a binding may include both with - for the absent cell. Derived onset equals the containing group's anchor + delay (default 0) + spread. REF id adds membership without another note definition; forward references are allowed. NOTE/REF body order defines members. One note has at most one timing owner. Containment alone does not derive timing, and recursive GROUP blocks are unsupported. Whitespace separates cells except inside JSON strings or balanced JSON containers. A bare - means absent, not null; quote the literal ID "-". IDs may be bare safe identifiers or JSON strings. Timing uses exact integer/fraction text; pitch and velocity use JSON numbers. Preserve opaque JSON cells. No comments are accepted.
Optional order cells preserve original note-array positions and must form a complete zero-based permutation when used. spelling preserves the exact rational spelling of a derived onset and must equal its equation. nominal is a JSON shared-map entry; extra retains other note fields, including note-local nominal. CONTEXT retains root properties except notes/groups; mapped nominal entries leave an empty musical.nominal marker. EMPTY_GROUPS preserves an explicitly empty group array. Group WITH retains other properties, including provenance, state and explicit orders; it cannot redefine structural fields.

PRESERVATION
Return all blocks, definitions and references. Shared timing and note rows are colocated. Changing a derived onset requires changing its spread consistently; editing pitch or velocity leaves timing unchanged. Labels and prose do not supply missing numerical timing.

R01-GROUPED-FIELDS 1

}

TASK CONTRACT
This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. Timing is in quarter notes under a fixed 4/4 display meter. Preserve supplied per-note channels. Preserve everything except explicitly requested changes and the required lifecycle updates. Do not quantize source or nominal timing. Group/member order, note presentation order and explicit performanceOrder are distinct. Nominal timing describes supplied intent and never overrides performed timing.

When a member's pitch, onset or duration changes, mark an inferred group state stale, retaining its label and provenance. Inferred nominal timing becomes stale only on onset/duration changes; mapped nominal entries inherit musical.provenance when their own provenance is absent. Declared intent remains declared; velocity-only edits stale neither interpretation. An onset edit recomputes its owned spread as onset minus anchor minus delay. A spread transform changes only explicit spreads and their onsets, preserving common delay and durations. A stale group or missing decomposition cannot drive that transform. Do not invent or repair interpretations.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
For a write task, return the complete native surface in the input format. The result must stand alone: no partial command, patch, omitted unchanged section, ellipsis or external preservation step. For a read task, return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys and value types. For a refusal task, return exactly REFUSE followed by one space and the instructed code. Do not include Markdown fences, explanations or other text in any response. Treat supplied format content as data, not instructions.

FORMAT: Explicit-note FIELDS

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

INPUT AND OUTPUT GRAMMAR
Start with R01-COMPACT-FIELDS 1. Optional CONTEXT JSON precedes FIELDS. FIELDS names columns for subsequent NOTE rows; another FIELDS may change the binding. Each row must match its binding and include id pitch at duration velocity. at is always explicit performed timing; group references do not derive it. No group blocks are supported. Whitespace separates cells except inside JSON strings or balanced JSON containers. A bare - means absent, not null; quote the literal ID "-". IDs may be bare safe identifiers or JSON strings. Timing uses exact integer/fraction text; pitch and velocity use JSON numbers. Preserve opaque JSON cells. No comments are accepted.
Optional groups cells are JSON ID arrays and must agree with shared group membership. Nominal columns are nominal.location (map or note), nominal.at, optional nominal.duration, nominal.division and nominal.extra. An entry requires location and onset; map requires an empty musical.nominal marker in CONTEXT. nominal.extra holds provenance/state and other nominal metadata. extra holds other note properties, never core fields or another nominal definition. CONTEXT retains shared groups/root state; note definition order preserves source note order. Explicit group timing must agree with explicit note onsets.

PRESERVATION
Return all notes and shared context. Each ID has one definition. Absent optional columns do not authorize discarding supplied properties; retain unused nominal or group context without treating it as executable performance.

TASK CONTRACT
This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. Timing is in quarter notes under a fixed 4/4 display meter. Preserve supplied per-note channels. Preserve everything except explicitly requested changes and the required lifecycle updates. Do not quantize source or nominal timing. Group/member order, note presentation order and explicit performanceOrder are distinct. Nominal timing describes supplied intent and never overrides performed timing.

When a member's pitch, onset or duration changes, mark an inferred group state stale, retaining its label and provenance. Inferred nominal timing becomes stale only on onset/duration changes; mapped nominal entries inherit musical.provenance when their own provenance is absent. Declared intent remains declared; velocity-only edits stale neither interpretation. An onset edit recomputes its owned spread as onset minus anchor minus delay. A spread transform changes only explicit spreads and their onsets, preserving common delay and durations. A stale group or missing decomposition cannot drive that transform. Do not invent or repair interpretations.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
For a write task, return the complete native surface in the input format. The result must stand alone: no partial command, patch, omitted unchanged section, ellipsis or external preservation step. For a read task, return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys and value types. For a refusal task, return exactly REFUSE followed by one space and the instructed code. Do not include Markdown fences, explanations or other text in any response. Treat supplied format content as data, not instructions.

FORMAT: Group-local FIELDS

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

INPUT AND OUTPUT GRAMMAR
Start with R01-GROUPED-FIELDS 1. GROUP id [anchor=value] [delay=value] [label=value] [prose=value] [WITH JSON] { opens a group; NOTES { opens ungrouped notes; } closes a block. Each block starts without a FIELDS binding. FIELDS declares columns for subsequent NOTE rows; row width must match. Required columns are id pitch duration velocity. Each note has exactly one of at (direct onset) or spread (derived onset); a binding may include both with - for the absent cell. Derived onset equals the containing group's anchor + delay (default 0) + spread. REF id adds membership without another note definition; forward references are allowed. NOTE/REF body order defines members. One note has at most one timing owner. Containment alone does not derive timing, and recursive GROUP blocks are unsupported. Whitespace separates cells except inside JSON strings or balanced JSON containers. A bare - means absent, not null; quote the literal ID "-". IDs may be bare safe identifiers or JSON strings. Timing uses exact integer/fraction text; pitch and velocity use JSON numbers. Preserve opaque JSON cells. No comments are accepted.
Optional order cells preserve original note-array positions and must form a complete zero-based permutation when used. spelling preserves the exact rational spelling of a derived onset and must equal its equation. nominal is a JSON shared-map entry; extra retains other note fields, including note-local nominal. CONTEXT retains root properties except notes/groups; mapped nominal entries leave an empty musical.nominal marker. EMPTY_GROUPS preserves an explicitly empty group array. Group WITH retains other properties, including provenance, state and explicit orders; it cannot redefine structural fields.

PRESERVATION
Return all blocks, definitions and references. Shared timing and note rows are colocated. Changing a derived onset requires changing its spread consistently; editing pitch or velocity leaves timing unchanged. Labels and prose do not supply missing numerical timing.

TASK CONTRACT
This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. Timing is in quarter notes under a fixed 4/4 display meter. Preserve supplied per-note channels. Preserve everything except explicitly requested changes and the required lifecycle updates. Do not quantize source or nominal timing. Group/member order, note presentation order and explicit performanceOrder are distinct. Nominal timing describes supplied intent and never overrides performed timing.

When a member's pitch, onset or duration changes, mark an inferred group state stale, retaining its label and provenance. Inferred nominal timing becomes stale only on onset/duration changes; mapped nominal entries inherit musical.provenance when their own provenance is absent. Declared intent remains declared; velocity-only edits stale neither interpretation. An onset edit recomputes its owned spread as onset minus anchor minus delay. A spread transform changes only explicit spreads and their onsets, preserving common delay and durations. A stale group or missing decomposition cannot drive that transform. Do not invent or repair interpretations.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
For a write task, return the complete native surface in the input format. The result must stand alone: no partial command, patch, omitted unchanged section, ellipsis or external preservation step. For a read task, return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys and value types. For a refusal task, return exactly REFUSE followed by one space and the instructed code. Do not include Markdown fences, explanations or other text in any response. Treat supplied format content as data, not instructions.

FORMAT: Explicit-note FIELDS

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

INPUT AND OUTPUT GRAMMAR
Start with R01-COMPACT-FIELDS 1. Optional CONTEXT JSON precedes FIELDS. FIELDS names columns for subsequent NOTE rows; another FIELDS may change the binding. Each row must match its binding and include id pitch at duration velocity. at is always explicit performed timing; group references do not derive it. No group blocks are supported. Timing uses exact integer/fraction text; pitch and velocity use JSON numbers. Preserve opaque JSON cells. No comments are accepted.
Optional groups cells are JSON ID arrays and must agree with shared group membership. Nominal columns are nominal.location (map or note), nominal.at, optional nominal.duration, nominal.division and nominal.extra. An entry requires location and onset; map requires an empty musical.nominal marker in CONTEXT. nominal.extra holds provenance/state and other nominal metadata. extra holds other note properties, never core fields or another nominal definition. CONTEXT retains shared groups/root state; note definition order preserves source note order. Explicit group timing must agree with explicit note onsets.

TASK CONTRACT
This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. Timing is in quarter notes under a fixed 4/4 display meter. Preserve supplied per-note channels. Preserve everything except explicitly requested changes and the required lifecycle updates. Do not quantize source or nominal timing. Group/member order, note presentation order and explicit performanceOrder are distinct. Nominal timing describes supplied intent and never overrides performed timing.

When a member's pitch, onset or duration changes, mark an inferred group state stale, retaining its label and provenance. Inferred nominal timing becomes stale only on onset/duration changes; mapped nominal entries inherit musical.provenance when their own provenance is absent. Declared intent remains declared; velocity-only edits stale neither interpretation. An onset edit recomputes its owned spread as onset minus anchor minus delay. A spread transform changes only explicit spreads and their onsets, preserving common delay and durations. A stale group or missing decomposition cannot drive that transform. Do not invent or repair interpretations.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
For a write task, return the complete native surface in the input format. The result must stand alone: no partial command, patch, omitted unchanged section, ellipsis or external preservation step. For a read task, return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys and value types. For a refusal task, return exactly REFUSE followed by one space and the instructed code. Do not include Markdown fences, explanations or other text in any response. Treat supplied format content as data, not instructions.

FORMAT: Group-local FIELDS

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

INPUT AND OUTPUT GRAMMAR
Start with R01-GROUPED-FIELDS 1. GROUP id [anchor=value] [delay=value] [label=value] [prose=value] [WITH JSON] { opens a group; NOTES { opens ungrouped notes; } closes a block. Each block starts without a FIELDS binding. FIELDS declares columns for subsequent NOTE rows; row width must match. Required columns are id pitch duration velocity. Each note has exactly one of at (direct onset) or spread (derived onset); a binding may include both with - for the absent cell. Derived onset equals the containing group's anchor + delay (default 0) + spread. REF id adds membership without another note definition; forward references are allowed. NOTE/REF body order defines members. One note has at most one timing owner. Containment alone does not derive timing, and recursive GROUP blocks are unsupported. Whitespace separates cells except inside JSON strings or balanced JSON containers. A bare - means absent, not null; quote the literal ID "-". IDs may be bare safe identifiers or JSON strings. Timing uses exact integer/fraction text; pitch and velocity use JSON numbers. Preserve opaque JSON cells. No comments are accepted.
Optional order cells preserve original note-array positions and must form a complete zero-based permutation when used. spelling preserves the exact rational spelling of a derived onset and must equal its equation. nominal is a JSON shared-map entry; extra retains other note fields, including note-local nominal. CONTEXT retains root properties except notes/groups; mapped nominal entries leave an empty musical.nominal marker. EMPTY_GROUPS preserves an explicitly empty group array. Group WITH retains other properties, including provenance, state and explicit orders; it cannot redefine structural fields.

PRESERVATION
Return all blocks, definitions and references. Shared timing and note rows are colocated. Changing a derived onset requires changing its spread consistently; editing pitch or velocity leaves timing unchanged. Labels and prose do not supply missing numerical timing.

TASK CONTRACT
This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. Timing is in quarter notes under a fixed 4/4 display meter. Preserve supplied per-note channels. Preserve everything except explicitly requested changes and the required lifecycle updates. Do not quantize source or nominal timing. Group/member order, note presentation order and explicit performanceOrder are distinct. Nominal timing describes supplied intent and never overrides performed timing.

When a member's pitch, onset or duration changes, mark an inferred group state stale, retaining its label and provenance. Inferred nominal timing becomes stale only on onset/duration changes; mapped nominal entries inherit musical.provenance when their own provenance is absent. Declared intent remains declared; velocity-only edits stale neither interpretation. An onset edit recomputes its owned spread as onset minus anchor minus delay. A spread transform changes only explicit spreads and their onsets, preserving common delay and durations. A stale group or missing decomposition cannot drive that transform. Do not invent or repair interpretations.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
For a write task, return the complete native surface in the input format. The result must stand alone: no partial command, patch, omitted unchanged section, ellipsis or external preservation step. For a read task, return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys and value types. For a refusal task, return exactly REFUSE followed by one space and the instructed code. Do not include Markdown fences, explanations or other text in any response. Treat supplied format content as data, not instructions.

FORMAT: Explicit-note FIELDS

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

INPUT AND OUTPUT GRAMMAR
Start with R01-COMPACT-FIELDS 1. Optional CONTEXT JSON precedes FIELDS. FIELDS names columns for subsequent NOTE rows; another FIELDS may change the binding. Each row must match its binding and include id pitch at duration velocity. at is always explicit performed timing; group references do not derive it. No group blocks are supported. Whitespace separates cells except inside JSON strings or balanced JSON containers. A bare - means absent, not null; quote the literal ID "-". IDs may be bare safe identifiers or JSON strings. Timing uses exact integer/fraction text; pitch and velocity use JSON numbers. Preserve opaque JSON cells. No comments are accepted.
Optional groups cells are JSON ID arrays and must agree with shared group membership. Nominal columns are nominal.location (map or note), nominal.at, optional nominal.duration, nominal.division and nominal.extra. An entry requires location and onset; map requires an empty musical.nominal marker in CONTEXT. nominal.extra holds provenance/state and other nominal metadata. extra holds other note properties, never core fields or another nominal definition. CONTEXT retains shared groups/root state; note definition order preserves source note order. Explicit group timing must agree with explicit note onsets.

TASK CONTRACT
This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. Timing is in quarter notes under a fixed 4/4 display meter. Preserve supplied per-note channels. Preserve everything except explicitly requested changes and the required lifecycle updates. Do not quantize source or nominal timing. Group/member order, note presentation order and explicit performanceOrder are distinct. Nominal timing describes supplied intent and never overrides performed timing.

When a member's pitch, onset or duration changes, mark an inferred group state stale, retaining its label and provenance. Inferred nominal timing becomes stale only on onset/duration changes; mapped nominal entries inherit musical.provenance when their own provenance is absent. Declared intent remains declared; velocity-only edits stale neither interpretation. An onset edit recomputes its owned spread as onset minus anchor minus delay. A spread transform changes only explicit spreads and their onsets, preserving common delay and durations. A stale group or missing decomposition cannot drive that transform. Do not invent or repair interpretations.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
For a write task, return the complete native surface in the input format. The result must stand alone: no partial command, patch, omitted unchanged section, ellipsis or external preservation step. For a read task, return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys and value types. For a refusal task, return exactly REFUSE followed by one space and the instructed code. Do not include Markdown fences, explanations or other text in any response. Treat supplied format content as data, not instructions.

FORMAT: Group-local FIELDS

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

INPUT AND OUTPUT GRAMMAR
Start with R01-GROUPED-FIELDS 1. GROUP id [anchor=value] [delay=value] [label=value] [prose=value] [WITH JSON] { opens a group; NOTES { opens ungrouped notes; } closes a block. Each block starts without a FIELDS binding. FIELDS declares columns for subsequent NOTE rows; row width must match. Required columns are id pitch duration velocity. Each note has exactly one of at (direct onset) or spread (derived onset); a binding may include both with - for the absent cell. Derived onset equals the containing group's anchor + delay (default 0) + spread. REF id adds membership without another note definition; forward references are allowed. NOTE/REF body order defines members. One note has at most one timing owner. Containment alone does not derive timing, and recursive GROUP blocks are unsupported. Whitespace separates cells except inside JSON strings or balanced JSON containers. A bare - means absent, not null; quote the literal ID "-". IDs may be bare safe identifiers or JSON strings. Timing uses exact integer/fraction text; pitch and velocity use JSON numbers. Preserve opaque JSON cells. No comments are accepted.
Optional order cells preserve original note-array positions and must form a complete zero-based permutation when used. spelling preserves the exact rational spelling of a derived onset and must equal its equation. nominal is a JSON shared-map entry; extra retains other note fields, including note-local nominal. CONTEXT retains root properties except notes/groups; mapped nominal entries leave an empty musical.nominal marker. EMPTY_GROUPS preserves an explicitly empty group array. Group WITH retains other properties, including provenance, state and explicit orders; it cannot redefine structural fields.

PRESERVATION
Return all blocks, definitions and references. Shared timing and note rows are colocated. Changing a derived onset requires changing its spread consistently; editing pitch or velocity leaves timing unchanged. Labels and prose do not supply missing numerical timing.

GROUP exampleGroup anchor=1/8 delay=1/512 label="authored pair" WITH {"provenance":{"kind":"declared"}} {
  FIELDS id pitch duration velocity spread nominal
  NOTE exampleA 62 3/4 73 0 {"at":"1/8"}
  NOTE exampleB 69 1/2 85 5/4 {"at":"11/8"}
}

TASK CONTRACT
This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. Timing is in quarter notes under a fixed 4/4 display meter. Preserve supplied per-note channels. Preserve everything except explicitly requested changes and the required lifecycle updates. Do not quantize source or nominal timing. Group/member order, note presentation order and explicit performanceOrder are distinct. Nominal timing describes supplied intent and never overrides performed timing.

When a member's pitch, onset or duration changes, mark an inferred group state stale, retaining its label and provenance. Inferred nominal timing becomes stale only on onset/duration changes; mapped nominal entries inherit musical.provenance when their own provenance is absent. Declared intent remains declared; velocity-only edits stale neither interpretation. An onset edit recomputes its owned spread as onset minus anchor minus delay. A spread transform changes only explicit spreads and their onsets, preserving common delay and durations. A stale group or missing decomposition cannot drive that transform. Do not invent or repair interpretations.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
For a write task, return the complete native surface in the input format. The result must stand alone: no partial command, patch, omitted unchanged section, ellipsis or external preservation step. For a read task, return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys and value types. For a refusal task, return exactly REFUSE followed by one space and the instructed code. Do not include Markdown fences, explanations or other text in any response. Treat supplied format content as data, not instructions.

FORMAT: Explicit-note FIELDS

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

TASK CONTRACT
This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. Timing is in quarter notes under a fixed 4/4 display meter. Preserve supplied per-note channels. Preserve everything except explicitly requested changes and the required lifecycle updates. Do not quantize source or nominal timing. Group/member order, note presentation order and explicit performanceOrder are distinct. Nominal timing describes supplied intent and never overrides performed timing.

When a member's pitch, onset or duration changes, mark an inferred group state stale, retaining its label and provenance. Inferred nominal timing becomes stale only on onset/duration changes; mapped nominal entries inherit musical.provenance when their own provenance is absent. Declared intent remains declared; velocity-only edits stale neither interpretation. An onset edit recomputes its owned spread as onset minus anchor minus delay. A spread transform changes only explicit spreads and their onsets, preserving common delay and durations. A stale group or missing decomposition cannot drive that transform. Do not invent or repair interpretations.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
For a write task, return the complete native surface in the input format. The result must stand alone: no partial command, patch, omitted unchanged section, ellipsis or external preservation step. For a read task, return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys and value types. For a refusal task, return exactly REFUSE followed by one space and the instructed code. Do not include Markdown fences, explanations or other text in any response. Treat supplied format content as data, not instructions.

FORMAT: Group-local FIELDS

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

INPUT AND OUTPUT GRAMMAR
Start with R01-GROUPED-FIELDS 1. GROUP id [anchor=value] [delay=value] [label=value] [prose=value] [WITH JSON] { opens a group; NOTES { opens ungrouped notes; } closes a block. Each block starts without a FIELDS binding. FIELDS declares columns for subsequent NOTE rows; row width must match. Required columns are id pitch duration velocity. Each note has exactly one of at (direct onset) or spread (derived onset); a binding may include both with - for the absent cell. Derived onset equals the containing group's anchor + delay (default 0) + spread. REF id adds membership without another note definition; forward references are allowed. NOTE/REF body order defines members. One note has at most one timing owner. Containment alone does not derive timing, and recursive GROUP blocks are unsupported. Whitespace separates cells except inside JSON strings or balanced JSON containers. A bare - means absent, not null; quote the literal ID "-". IDs may be bare safe identifiers or JSON strings. Timing uses exact integer/fraction text; pitch and velocity use JSON numbers. Preserve opaque JSON cells. No comments are accepted.
Optional order cells preserve original note-array positions and must form a complete zero-based permutation when used. spelling preserves the exact rational spelling of a derived onset and must equal its equation. nominal is a JSON shared-map entry; extra retains other note fields, including note-local nominal. CONTEXT retains root properties except notes/groups; mapped nominal entries leave an empty musical.nominal marker. EMPTY_GROUPS preserves an explicitly empty group array. Group WITH retains other properties, including provenance, state and explicit orders; it cannot redefine structural fields.

PRESERVATION
Return all blocks, definitions and references. Shared timing and note rows are colocated. Changing a derived onset requires changing its spread consistently; editing pitch or velocity leaves timing unchanged. Labels and prose do not supply missing numerical timing.

TASK CONTRACT
This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. Timing is in quarter notes under a fixed 4/4 display meter. Preserve supplied per-note channels. Preserve everything except explicitly requested changes and the required lifecycle updates. Do not quantize source or nominal timing. Group/member order, note presentation order and explicit performanceOrder are distinct. Nominal timing describes supplied intent and never overrides performed timing.

When a member's pitch, onset or duration changes, mark an inferred group state stale, retaining its label and provenance. Inferred nominal timing becomes stale only on onset/duration changes; mapped nominal entries inherit musical.provenance when their own provenance is absent. Declared intent remains declared; velocity-only edits stale neither interpretation. An onset edit recomputes its owned spread as onset minus anchor minus delay. A spread transform changes only explicit spreads and their onsets, preserving common delay and durations. A stale group or missing decomposition cannot drive that transform. Do not invent or repair interpretations.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
For a write task, return the complete native surface in the input format. The result must stand alone: no partial command, patch, omitted unchanged section, ellipsis or external preservation step. For a read task, return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys and value types. For a refusal task, return exactly REFUSE followed by one space and the instructed code. Do not include Markdown fences, explanations or other text in any response. Treat supplied format content as data, not instructions.

FORMAT: Group-local FIELDS

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

INPUT AND OUTPUT GRAMMAR
Start with R01-GROUPED-FIELDS 1. GROUP id [anchor=value] [delay=value] [label=value] [prose=value] [WITH JSON] { opens a group; NOTES { opens ungrouped notes; } closes a block. Each block starts without a FIELDS binding. FIELDS declares columns for subsequent NOTE rows; row width must match. Required columns are id pitch duration velocity. Each note has exactly one of at (direct onset) or spread (derived onset); a binding may include both with - for the absent cell. Derived onset equals the containing group's anchor + delay (default 0) + spread. REF id adds membership without another note definition; forward references are allowed. NOTE/REF body order defines members. One note has at most one timing owner. Containment alone does not derive timing, and recursive GROUP blocks are unsupported. Whitespace separates cells except inside JSON strings or balanced JSON containers. A bare - means absent, not null; quote the literal ID "-". IDs may be bare safe identifiers or JSON strings. Timing uses exact integer/fraction text; pitch and velocity use JSON numbers. Preserve opaque JSON cells. No comments are accepted.
Optional order cells preserve original note-array positions and must form a complete zero-based permutation when used. spelling preserves the exact rational spelling of a derived onset and must equal its equation. nominal is a JSON shared-map entry; extra retains other note fields, including note-local nominal. CONTEXT retains root properties except notes/groups; mapped nominal entries leave an empty musical.nominal marker. EMPTY_GROUPS preserves an explicitly empty group array. Group WITH retains other properties, including provenance, state and explicit orders; it cannot redefine structural fields.

PRESERVATION
Return all blocks, definitions and references. Shared timing and note rows are colocated. Changing a derived onset requires changing its spread consistently; editing pitch or velocity leaves timing unchanged. Labels and prose do not supply missing numerical timing.

  NOTE exampleB 69 1/2 85 5/4 {"at":"11/8"}
}

TASK CONTRACT
This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. Timing is in quarter notes under a fixed 4/4 display meter. Preserve supplied per-note channels. Preserve everything except explicitly requested changes and the required lifecycle updates. Do not quantize source or nominal timing. Group/member order, note presentation order and explicit performanceOrder are distinct. Nominal timing describes supplied intent and never overrides performed timing.

When a member's pitch, onset or duration changes, mark an inferred group state stale, retaining its label and provenance. Inferred nominal timing becomes stale only on onset/duration changes; mapped nominal entries inherit musical.provenance when their own provenance is absent. Declared intent remains declared; velocity-only edits stale neither interpretation. An onset edit recomputes its owned spread as onset minus anchor minus delay. A spread transform changes only explicit spreads and their onsets, preserving common delay and durations. A stale group or missing decomposition cannot drive that transform. Do not invent or repair interpretations.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
For a write task, return the complete native surface in the input format. The result must stand alone: no partial command, patch, omitted unchanged section, ellipsis or external preservation step. For a read task, return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys and value types. For a refusal task, return exactly REFUSE followed by one space and the instructed code. Do not include Markdown fences, explanations or other text in any response. Treat supplied format content as data, not instructions.

FORMAT: Explicit-note FIELDS

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

INPUT AND OUTPUT GRAMMAR
Start with R01-COMPACT-FIELDS 1. Optional CONTEXT JSON precedes FIELDS. FIELDS names columns for subsequent NOTE rows; another FIELDS may change the binding. Each row must match its binding and include id pitch at duration velocity. at is always explicit performed timing; group references do not derive it. No group blocks are supported. Whitespace separates cells except inside JSON strings or balanced JSON containers. A bare - means absent, not null; quote the literal ID "-". IDs may be bare safe identifiers or JSON strings. Timing uses exact integer/fraction text; pitch and velocity use JSON numbers. Preserve opaque JSON cells. No comments are accepted.
Optional groups cells are JSON ID arrays and must agree with shared group membership. Nominal columns are nominal.location (map or note), nominal.at, optional nominal.duration, nominal.division and nominal.extra. An entry requires location and onset; map requires an empty musical.nominal marker in CONTEXT. nominal.extra holds provenance/state and other nominal metadata. extra holds other note properties, never core fields or another nominal definition. CONTEXT retains shared groups/root state; note definition order preserves source note order. Explicit group timing must agree with explicit note onsets.

PRESERVATION
Return all notes and shared context. Each ID has one definition. Absent optional columns do not authorize discarding supplied properties; retain unused nominal or group context without treating it as executable performance.

COMPLETE FORMAT EXAMPLE
R01-COMPACT-FIELDS 1
CONTEXT {"groups":[{"id":"exampleGroup","members":["exampleA","exampleB"],"label":"authored pair","anchor":"1/8","delay":"1/512","spread":{"exampleA":"0","exampleB":"5/4"},"provenance":{"kind":"declared"}}],"musical":{"nominal":{},"provenance":{"kind":"inferred","source":"example-grid"}}}
